result.summary: 本文提出了 Movie Gen，一组媒体生成基础模型，能够生成带同步音频的高质量 1080p 视频，并支持基于指令的视频编辑和基于用户图像的人物个性化视频生成 [abstract]。模型通过同时扩展训练数据、训练计算量和模型规模来训练基于 Transformer 和 Flow Matching 的生成模型，其中最大的视频生成模型为 30B 参数、最大上下文长度 73K 视频 token，对应 16 秒、16 FPS 的视频 [abstract][S1.p2]。作者在文本到视频、视频个性化、视频编辑、视频到音频和文本到音频等多个任务上报告了新的最优结果，并公开了两个基准以支持未来评测 [abstract][S1.p4]。作者希望这项工作能帮助研究社区加速媒体生成模型的进展与创新 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文关注的核心科学挑战是让 AI 系统具备生成、组合和预测能力，并以图像、视频、音频作为输出空间，而非像大语言模型那样以文本为输出空间 [S1.p1]。作者希望构建一组媒体生成基础模型，能够原生生成高保真图像、视频和音频，并具备编辑和个性化视频的能力 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: Equipping AI systems with such generative, compositional, and prediction capabilities is a core scientific challenge with broad applications.
While Large Language Models (LLMs) aim to learn such capabilities with a text output space, in this paper we focus on media – image, video, audio – as the output space.
Movie Gen models can natively generate high fidelity images, video, and audio while also possessing the abilities to edit and personalize the videos

method.text: 作者训练了一个联合的图像与视频基础模型 Movie Gen Video，将图像视为单帧视频，从而用同一模型生成图像和视频 [S3.p1]。训练分为多个阶段：先在低分辨率 256 px 图像上预训练，再进行低分辨率图像与视频联合预训练和高分辨率联合训练，最后在高品质视频上微调 [S3.p1]。模型架构为 Transformer，并紧密遵循 LLaMa3 的设计空间 [S3.T1]。此外，作者通过后训练为模型加入个性化能力，并采用多阶段方法训练视频编辑模型 [S2.p3][S5.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We train a single joint foundation model, Movie Gen Video, for the text-to-image and the text-to-video tasks.
We treat images as a single frame video, enabling us to use the same model to generate both images and videos.
We first pretrain our model only on low-resolution 256 px images followed by joint pre-training on low-resolution images and videos, and high-resolution joint training.
Our model architecture is a Transformer and we closely follow the LLaMa3 design space.
We add video personalization and video editing capabilities to our foundation Movie Gen Video model via post-training procedures
we introduce a multi-stage approach that progressively minimizes these discrepancies

experiments.text: 作者在文本到视频生成任务上，使用 Movie Gen Video Bench 提示集或公开视频提示，与 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs、Kling1.5 和 OpenAI Sora 等系统进行人类 A/B 对比评估 [S3.T6][S3.SS6.SSS1.p1]。作者公开了包含 1003 个提示的 Movie Gen Video Bench，覆盖人类活动、动物、自然风景、物理以及不寻常主体和活动等概念，并按高/中/低运动水平标注 [S3.SS5.SSS2.p1]。在视频编辑方面，作者在 TGVE+ 和自建的 Movie Gen Edit Bench 上评估，后者包含 64 个验证视频和 128 个测试视频，视频具有不同分辨率、FPS、长度和宽高比 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2][S5.SS3.SSS1.p3]。在音频生成方面，作者使用 VGGSound、OpenAI Sora、Runway Gen3 以及自建的 Movie Gen Audio Bench（527 个视频）等数据集进行评估 [S6.SS3.SSS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: The comparison uses either generated videos from the Movie Gen Video Bench prompt set (Runway Gen3, LumaLabs, Kling1.5) or prompts from publicly released videos on their website (OpenAI Sora).
which consists of 1003 prompts that cover all the different testing aspects summarized above

We specifically include prompts capturing the following concepts of interest: 1) human activity (limb and mouth motion, emotions, etc.), 2) animals, 3) nature and scenery, 4) physics (fluid dynamics, gravity, acceleration, collisions, explosions, etc.), 5) unusual subjects and unusual activities.
Overall, the benchmark validation set has 64 videos, whereas the test set has 128 videos.
we evaluate our method versus SDEdit and Runway Gen3 Video-to-Video
This includes VGGSound, OpenAI Sora, Runway Gen3, and our proposed Movie Gen Audio Bench.
It includes 527 videos and is designed to cover various ambient environments

findings.text: 在文本到视频生成上，Movie Gen Video 在整体质量上大幅优于 Runway Gen3（净胜率 35.02%）和 LumaLabs，对 OpenAI Sora 取得中等净胜（8.23%），与 Kling1.5 持平（3.87%）[S3.SS6.SSS1.p2]。在真实感和美学方面，Movie Gen Video 显著优于 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs 和 Kling1.5，对 OpenAI Sora 在真实感上取得显著净胜（11.62%），在美学上取得中等净胜（6.45%）[S3.SS6.SSS1.p3]。在视频编辑上，人类评估者在 TGVE+ 基准上偏好 Movie Gen Edit 超过此前最优方法 EVE 达 74% [S5.SS3.SSS1.p4]。在音频生成上，Movie Gen Audio 在所有指标上大幅优于所有基线，同步性净胜 33.8% 至 72.8%，正确性净胜 27.5% 至 82.2%，生成视频整体质量净胜 31.3% 至 91.0% [S6.SS4.SSS1.p3]。

evidence.quote: On overall quality, Movie Gen Video strongly outperforms Runway Gen3 (35.02%) and LumaLabs with the net win rate beyond $2\sigma$.
Our generations moderately net win over OpenAI Sora (8.23%) (net win rate within 1-2 $\sigma$) and are on par with Kling1.5 (3.87%).
Movie Gen Video significantly outperforms Runway Gen3, LumaLabs and Kling1.5 on both metrics, with 48.49%, 61.83% and 37.09% net win rates on realness, respectively.

Compared to OpenAI Sora, Movie Gen Video has a significant win on realness with 11.62% net win rate beyond $2\sigma$ and a moderate win over OpenAI Sora on aesthetics with 6.45% net win rate within 1–2 $\sigma$.
On the TGVE+ benchmark, our model is preferred 74% more often than the current state-of-the-art EVE in the overall Human evaluation criterion.

Movie Gen Audio outperforms all baselines on all metrics by a large margin: with 33.8% to 72.8% on synchronization, 27.5% to 82.2% on correctness for all videos, and 31.3% to 91.0% on overall quality for generated videos.

limitations.text: 作者指出，视频生成模型在复杂几何、物体操作、物体物理、状态变换等方面仍存在生成或编辑视频的伪影 [S8.p2]。生成音频在运动密集（如踢踏舞）、视觉上较小或被遮挡（如脚步声）或需要更细粒度视觉理解（如识别吉他和弦）时有时会不同步，且由于设计选择目前不支持语音生成 [S8.p2]。作者还指出，使用人类评估定义客观标准仍然具有挑战性，人类评估可能受到个人偏见、背景等因素影响 [S8.p2]。此外，模型分别针对视频和音频生成训练，开发能联合生成这些模态的模型是重要的研究方向 [S8.p2]。作者也说明本研究仅限于英语文本输入 [S8.p3]。

evidence.quote: we observe that video generation models still suffer from issues – artifacts in generated or edited videos around complex geometry, manipulation of objects, object physics, state transformations etc.

Generated audio is sometimes out of synchronization when motions are dense ( e.g., tap dance), visually small or occluded ( e.g., footsteps), or when it requires finer-grained visual understanding ( e.g., recognizing the guitar chords).
It currently does not support voice generation either due to our design choices.

defining objective criteria evaluating model generations using human evaluations remains challenging and thus human evaluations can be influenced by a number of other factors such as personal biases, backgrounds etc.
While our models are trained separately for video and audio generation, developing models that can generate these modalities jointly is an important area of research.
Our study in this paper is limited to text inputs in the English language.
